classes.description: Sampling Plan — 定义产品/来料的质量抽样检验策略。包含抽样率、AQL 等级、检验等级、切换规则等配置。可关联到 Spec 和 Resource，支持版本化管理（name+revision）。 【Swagger】Schema: SamplingPlanEntity；来源文件: SamplingPlans.json；API: /api/SamplingPlans。

properties.name: samplingPlanBase
properties.description: 抽样计划基线版本 → SamplingPlanBase (SamplingPlanBaseId)

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 关联的建模访问权限（A_SetupAccess）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: inspectionLevel
properties.description: 检验等级（I, II, III, S-1） → InspectionLevel (InspectionLevelId) 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: switchingRuleMaxDuration
properties.description: 切换规则有效最大天数 【Swagger】Maximum number of days since Product was last run before resetting the consecutive passes counter in the SamplingCurrentStatus

properties.name: status
properties.description: 状态：1=Active, 2=Inactive 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 工程变更单号 【Swagger】Engineering Change Order

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注信息 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: sampleRateMaxDuration
properties.description: 抽样率有效最大天数 【Swagger】Maximum number of days since Product was last run before resetting the counters for Rate

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 → ChangeStatus (ChangeHistoryId) 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联图标的标识符。 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 版本号（必填） 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: vendor
properties.description: 关联的供应商（来料检验） → Vendor (VendorId) 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.description: 关联的检验资源/设备 → Resource (ResourceId) 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.description: 样本量基于开始数量还是当前容器数量。 【Swagger】Determines if the Sample Size should be based on the Start Quantity or Current Container Qty

properties.name: sampleRate
properties.description: 默认抽样率 【Swagger】The default sampling rate for a sampling plan defined for every nth container. ex. If rate =1 then every container is sampled. If rate is 3 then ever 3rd container is sampled.

properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: moveContainerOnCompletion
properties.description: 检验完成后是否自动移动容器 【Swagger】Flag to determine whether to move the container when sampling is completed and passed
